title: Polar Parade ABC
hook: Land, ice, sea—each body finds a way.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: friendly 3D polar storybook, icy blue and white with warm accents, rounded wildlife, uncluttered foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing honest ways animals cross land, ice, air and cold water
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reset the land-ice-sea movement map rather than force all animals into marching
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: light 4/4 with grounded steps, open flight phrases and fluid swim tails
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written locomotion contrasts; nonliving ice, tundra and quartz anchor movement instead of being made to move like animals
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: surface/motion cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe abstract gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft bell sparkle after targets over a warm acoustic pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft bell sparkle after targets over a warm acoustic pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn the polar parade into a study of movement across three surfaces—snow, ice and sea—so walking, flying, diving and swimming replace a generic marching-song idea.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child watches transitions between land, ice edge, air and water; recurring language uses step, slide, dive, surface, cross, launch and return.
semanticArc: return to tundra and shore with many movement types
